title: Vertex bound for reachable states
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $E$ be a relation on the natural numbers, and let $K,L,t$ be natural numbers. Define membership by requiring that some initial vertex $u<K$ satisfies the initial predicate and that $t$ is reachable from $u$ by a walk of length at most $K$, with every step following $E$ through an intermediate vertex below $n$. If $t$ belongs to this set for the specified $K,E,L$ and initial predicate, then $t<K$.
hypotheses_covered: An initial predicate on natural numbers
There is an initial vertex $u<K$ satisfying the initial predicate, with a walk of length at most $K$ from $u$ to $t$ whose steps follow $E$ through vertices below $n$
